request.message: How many days after the end of the first fiscal quarter of Physician Sales & Service, Inc. must the financial results of post-Merger combined operations be published?

response.answer: PSS must publish the financial results of post-Merger combined operations within 45 days after the end of the first fiscal quarter of PSS containing the required period of post-Merger combined operations. [E1]

evidences.doc_title: Gulf South Medical Supply Affiliate Agreement (1997)
section_path: 2. Initial Restriction on Disposition. The undersigned agrees that he
evidences.text:
understands that ASR 130 and 135 relate to publication of financial results of
post-Merger combined operations of PSS and GSMS. PSS agrees that it will publish
such results as promptly as practicable following the Merger in the sole
discretion of PSS, but in any event within 45 days after the end of the first
fiscal quarter of PSS containing the required period of post-Merger combined
operations and that it will notify the undersigned promptly following such
publication.
